    Compute summary statistics by group

    get_stats.Rd

    The get_stats function calculates summary statistics for a specified numeric column, grouped by a given categorical column. It returns the number of observations, mean, standard deviation, standard error of the mean (SEM), and margin of error (MOE) for each group.

    get_stats(df, value_column, grouping_column)

    Arguments

    df

    A data frame containing the input data.

    value_column

    A string specifying the name of the numeric column for which statistics are computed.

    grouping_column

    A string specifying the name of the column used to group the data.

    Value

    A data frame with the following columns:

    • grouping_column — the column of grouping variables,

    • n — number of observations in the group,

    • mean — mean value,

    • sd — standard deviation,

    • SEM — standard error of the mean,

    • MOE — margin of error (95

    Examples

    df <- data.frame(
  group = rep(c("A", "B"), each = 10),
  value = rnorm(20)
)
get_stats(df, "value", "group")
#> # A tibble: 2 × 6
#>   group     n   mean    sd   SEM   MOE
#>   <chr> <int>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 A        10 -0.441  1.12 0.353 0.800
#> 2 B        10 -0.179  1.18 0.372 0.841
